description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing JournalEntryAggregationTracking entities, including methods to find the latest aggregation date and delete records by job execution ID.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationTrackingRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for JournalEntryAggregationTracking entities, providing methods for custom queries and data modifications.

methods.name: findLatestAggregatedOnDate
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent date up to which journal entries have been aggregated.

methods.name: deleteByJobExecutionId
methods.description: Deletes journal entry aggregation tracking records by specific job execution ID.
